title: Treat text as text
summary: User-supplied text should not become executable page code by accident. textContent places text into a page without treating it as HTML.
introduction: User-supplied text should not become executable page code by accident. textContent places text into a page without treating it as HTML. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: User-supplied text should not become executable page code by accident. textContent places text into a page without treating it as HTML.
The console prints the literal text Hello. It is not turned into a bold element by textContent.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Use another string containing angle brackets.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not put untrusted text into innerHTML. Choose a safe text API when you need text.
For more detail later, use this [Cybersecurity Fundamentals further reading](https://www.cisa.gov/secure-our-world).
